biography: A.J. Myers, a name synonymous with audacious overtakes and a flair for the dramatic, hails from the unassuming town of Harmony Creek, Ohio. His racing journey began not on asphalt, but on dirt, tearing around the family farm on a battered four-wheeler. The transition to karting was inevitable; at 14, he entered his first local karting race in a borrowed machine, stunning onlookers by taking the lead halfway through before a mechanical failure ended his run. This initial taste of victory fueled an insatiable hunger. He honed his skills in the unforgiving Kart 2-Stroke 125cc Shifter series, a proving ground for raw talent. Myers quickly gained a reputation for his aggressive driving and unwavering self-belief. Despite facing setbacks – a devastating engine blow-up in the 2018 national championship that cost him the title – Myers persevered, showcasing an unshakeable resilience. Now, at 28, he stands at what many believe to be the peak of his career, seeking to translate his karting prowess into a larger racing platform and prove that his 'flashy' style can indeed lead to consistent wins.
drivingStyle: Myers' driving style can be best described as 'controlled chaos.' He's known for his late braking maneuvers, often diving into corners with a level of commitment that leaves rivals shaking their heads. Tire management isn't his forte; he tends to push the limits early, sacrificing long-run pace for the thrill of immediate gains. Under pressure, Myers either thrives, pulling off improbable passes, or implodes, making rash decisions that lead to costly mistakes. This high-risk, high-reward approach makes him a compelling, if unpredictable, competitor.

rivalries.reason: A clash of styles. Silva's calculated precision is the antithesis of Myers' impulsive aggression, leading to frequent on-track battles and heated post-race exchanges.
Dubois and Myers have a history of close calls, particularly after Myers aggressively overtook her at the 2021 Regional Championship, leading to a spin for Dubois and a subsequent penalty for Myers.
Blake has always been technically superior, but Myers believes he lacks the guts to really push it. This has led to Myers showing off on the track, trying to prove he's the better driver.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky (and slightly worn) racing gloves for every race.
Listens to a specific heavy metal song ('Fuel for the Fire' by an obscure band) exactly three times before each race.
Insists on personally inspecting and cleaning his kart's air filter before every session, regardless of its condition.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser to me, you dig? I race to win, not to participate.
careerHighlight: Winning the 2019 Karting Grand Prix at Willow Springs. After starting in P5, he executed a series of daring overtakes in the final laps to snatch victory, solidifying his reputation as a fearless competitor.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2020 National Karting Championship due to overzealous driving. The incident cost him the championship and resulted in a fractured wrist.
